messages:
Taylor (sales): Heads-up: HealthBridge POC hitting frequent 429s during a bulk embeddings ingest. Demo scheduled for tomorrow AM. Need quick triage.

Ravi (SE): How many parallel clients and approx tokens per call? Any X-RateLimit headers?

Taylor (sales): 6 parallel workers, ~800 tokens each. Header shows X-RateLimit-Remaining: sometimes 0, Retry-After: 10. Error body says 'per-route token budget exceeded'.

Elena (eng): That error usually means the per-route short-window quota tripped. Are they trial tenants?

Taylor (sales): Yes, trial account.

Nora (sre): Confirmed: trials have a 60s burst window per-route. We rolled a stricter window last month. If they're streaming and doing prefix probes the accounting can look worse.

Ravi (SE): Their client streams and also does a small probe call per item. Streaming + probe can lead to double token accounting. Workarounds: lower concurrency to 2, increase batch size to 3-4k tokens, or add exponential backoff on 429.

Taylor (sales): Can SRE do a temporary bump for the tenant so demo isn't blocked?

Nora (sre): I can apply a temporary soft bump (2x) for 24h for tenant=healthbridge and enable verbose quota logging. Applying now.

quota-bot: quota-service: softcap applied multiplier=2 for tenant=healthbridge until 1781310967.

Elena (eng): I'll open INF-901 to investigate double-charging when streaming triggers prefix cache lookups. ETA 72h for fix. Also will add a metric to detect double-charge occurrences.

Ravi (SE): Sent a small client snippet to implement simple retry + chunking: try 3 retries with backoff and use chunks of ~3.5k tokens.

Taylor (sales): HealthBridge reran import with concurrency=2 and 3.5k chunks. They reported fewer 429s and most items completed after retries. They asked about billing — will these retries increase billed tokens?

Nora (sre): Billing remains standard; softcap doesn't change billing. Retries may increase usage counted but the accounting fix will address double-counted events moving forward.

Taylor (sales): Thanks team. Please keep this thread updated if the fix uncovers anything else. I'll confirm after the demo. :thumbsup:
